comments.content: `sourceLanguage` became a hard requirement here, but the documented default ("default is zh") never reaches this method. Tool arguments are deserialized by Jackson into the record's canonical constructor, so a call omitting `sourceLanguage` produces `sourceLanguage == null`; the convenience `Request(String text)` constructor (which injects `LANGUAGE_CODE_ZH`) is only used for direct Java construction. The result is a silent `null` response for the very request shape the schema advertises as defaulted. Prefer falling back to `LANGUAGE_CODE_ZH` (or `"auto"`) instead of rejecting the request.

This `catch (Exception e)` also swallows `InterruptedException` from `response.get()` without restoring the interrupt flag, and it discards the throwable (`e.getMessage()` on an `ExecutionException` drops the underlying SDK error and the whole stack trace), so the new `IllegalStateException` validations from `getTranslatedText` become undiagnosable. Handle interruption explicitly and log the exception object.

Renaming the public constant `LANGUAGE_CODE` to `LANGUAGE_CODE_ZH` (together with adding a `sourceLanguage` component to `Request`, which changes its canonical constructor arity) is a source/binary-incompatible change for downstream users of this starter. Consider keeping a deprecated alias to soften the break.

The environment fallbacks use bare `ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `ACCESS_KEY_SECRET`. These are generic names that can be populated by unrelated tooling/credentials on the same machine, and they do not follow Alibaba Cloud's official `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` convention. Other starters in this module prefix env vars with the tool name (e.g. `BAIDU_MAP_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_APIKEY`), so consider using a prefixed name (e.g. `ALITRANSLATE_ACCESS_KEY_ID`) or the official Alibaba Cloud variable names.
